title: ServiceConfig
description:
An operator-facing service declaration from `.yah/services/<svc>/service.toml`.

A service groups one or more components (a static surface, a containerized API, an almanac…) under a single domain. Mirrors project the service onto concrete infra; see [`MirrorConfig`].

GitSource.description:
A git source for a component (R561-F1, "BYO git").

When a [`ServiceComponent`] sets `git`, the component's code is NOT in this workspace — it lives in an external repo that the reconciler shallow-clones into a source cache before build (approach A: clone-at-reconcile, so config load + validation stay offline). The component's `path` is then interpreted relative to `<checkout>/<subdir>` instead of the workspace root.

ref.description: Branch, tag, or commit SHA to check out. Defaults to `"main"`.

repo.description: Clone URL (https or ssh) of the tenant repo.

subdir.description: Optional sub-directory within the repo that the workspace is rooted at (e.g. a monorepo's `site/`). `path` is resolved relative to this.

ServiceComponent.description: One component of a [`ServiceConfig`]. The `kind` (e.g. `"mesofact-static"`, `"almanac"`, `"container"`) selects which reconciler runs against the pointed-at workload manifest.

git.description: Optional external git source (R561-F1). When set, the component's code is materialized by shallow-clone before build; see [`GitSource`].

path.description: Path of the directory holding this component's `workload.toml`. Relative to the workspace root for in-tree components, or to the materialized `<checkout>/<subdir>` when [`git`](Self::git) is set.

publishes.description: Optional artifact kind this component publishes (`"static"`, `"container-image"`, …). Drives mirror provider-slot routing.

wave.description: Sync-wave index (0-based). Components in wave 0 roll out in parallel first; the reconciler waits for all wave-N components to become healthy before starting wave N+1. Defaults to 0 (all components in one wave).
